svg.title: Flectar — Launch plan, October 2026
svg.desc: Internal release plan with document controls, scope, delivery schedule, readiness criteria and open actions.

g.aria-label: Release the desktop beta to an initial group of 100 users from the waiting list.
The release includes mail, calendar, contacts and files on macOS, Windows and Linux.
Android remains in preview and is excluded from this release approval.
Confirm scope and prioritise open defects
Approve setup guide and release notes
Issue first batch of beta invitations
Account setup, sending and sync pass for each provider
Install, update and offline access pass on each platform
No unresolved critical or high-severity defects
Release approval: Product and Engineering sign-off required before invitations are sent.
• Confirm support coverage for the first weekend. Owner: Alex Morgan.
• Verify rollback steps on all desktop installers. Owner: Sam Chen.
Both actions are due at the 21 September release review.
